helper_version: prefix_audit.py v1, local standalone quadratic_audit.py v1 pinned by pilot/main
family: quadratic phases with arbitrary ordinary query prefixes and arbitrary optional actual product resets
domain: all alternating matrices n=0..4; all physical outcomes, coordinate orders, stopping cuts, and optional reset decisions
case_count: 76 matrix roots; finite memoized recursion over all reachable truth-table/reference states
symmetry: linear characters translate all spectral laws and references by the same mask; constant phases cancel. Kernel transport, zero-source extension, normalization, and KL are covariant under that translation, so all linear and constant terms have the same costs
arithmetic: Fraction references; compare exponentiated KL/reset prices as exact rational numbers, no floating logarithms
pilot: all graphs n<=3, all histories; under 60 seconds
fixed_limits: main n<=4; cache at most 20000 states; no automatic dimension increase; one job at a time
